purpose: Compare-and-swap delivery state that prevents campaign completion before an explicit selected result or prepared/no-delivery closure.
completion_rule: Only CLOSED with a selected outcome, or CLOSED with PREPARED_NO_DELIVERY, is campaign-completion eligible.
unknown_rule: UNKNOWN and FAILED are never completion-eligible. Re-entry preserves the failed or unknown receipt, clears active execution evidence, and requires a fresh owner-selected choice before authorization can resume.
